candidate_sentence_map.S1: AS Tallinna Sadam Group’s 2025 performance improved overall, with stronger profitability despite a slight decline in revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue decreased by EUR 0.9 million, or 0.8%, to EUR 118.7 million, mainly because of lower charter income from the icebreaker Botnica.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: This was largely offset by recovery in the passenger and cargo businesses.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Cargo volume increased by 5.1% to 13.8 million tonnes, supported particularly by higher liquid bulk volumes, while passenger numbers rose by 1.0% to 8.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Revenue growth was recorded in all operating segments except Other, which includes Botnica.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Vessel dues increased by 8% to EUR 34.1 million, while lease income rose by 3% to EUR 14.6 million, passenger fees by 3% to EUR 12.2 million, cargo charges by 3% to EUR 6.9 million, and ferry service revenue by 1% to EUR 36.4 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Botnica charter fees fell by EUR 4.0 million, or 34%, to EUR 7.9 million, as charter days declined by 42 and utilization decreased to 49%.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: In the segment results, Cargo harbours produced the strongest improvement: revenue rose 5% to EUR 33.4 million and adjusted EBITDA increased 19% to EUR 16.9 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Passenger harbours’ adjusted EBITDA rose 5% to EUR 20.8 million, while Ferry adjusted EBITDA declined 2% to EUR 15.2 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Cost reductions supported the improvement in margins.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Operating expenses fell by EUR 4.0 million, or 10%, to EUR 36.4 million, primarily because of lower maintenance and repair costs, while impairment losses on financial assets declined substantially.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Personnel expenses increased by 3% to EUR 26.6 million despite a reduction in average employees from 438 to 425.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Operating profit increased by 12.2% to EUR 32.7 million, raising the operating margin from 24.4% to 27.6%.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Adjusted EBITDA rose 6.4% to EUR 56.5 million, and the margin improved from 44.4% to 47.6%.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Profit before tax increased by 25% to EUR 27.9 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Net profit rose 17.3% to EUR 22.5 million, or EUR 0.09 per share, supported by a 30% reduction in finance costs as interest rates and debt declined.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Growth was partly limited by higher dividend-related income tax of EUR 5.4 million and a EUR 26 thousand loss from Green Marine, compared with a EUR 0.5 million profit in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Operating cash flow increased to EUR 53.7 million from EUR 48.7 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Capital investment decreased 14.4% to EUR 33.2 million, mainly reflecting completion of the multifunctional quay at Paldiski South Harbour.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Cash and cash equivalents rose to EUR 32.0 million, while net debt fell 15.5% to EUR 141.7 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: However, current liabilities exceeded current assets by EUR 66.0 million because significant loan and bond maturities fall in 2026; management is considering refinancing or extending maturities.
candidate_sentence_map.S23: The Group paid EUR 19.2 million in dividends for 2024 and proposed the same EUR 0.073 per share dividend for 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S24: For 2026, management expects continued moderate passenger and cargo recovery but anticipates pressure from higher input and financing costs, and therefore expects operating and net profit may decline.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, and K7 are PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K6 and K8 are MISSING as there is no mention of the Russia-Ukraine war impacts or environmental sustainability metrics. The summary captures most core financial and operational highlights, but the absence of two HIGH/MEDIUM criteria (war impact and sustainability) prevents a 'Yes' rating. The overall picture is captured, but important omissions remain, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.
